Spindle Bearings: Arrangements and Precision Classes

en.<p>스핀들 베어링 치수표는 모두 UL(자유조합형) 단품이며, 고객이 2:
All spindle bearings in the tables are UL (universal matching) single bearings, which the customer mounts in combinations of two or more.
There is no separate part number after matching; the arrangement toggle in the tables lets you switch between UL/DB/DT designations.
DB (back-to-back, O arrangement) — Strong against tilting moments.
DF (face-to-face, X arrangement) — Advantageous for shaft deflection.
DT (tandem) — Shares a load in one direction.

The smaller the number after P, the higher the precision.

Our stock tables are based on preload class L (light preload) · UL.
